description: ZEROAI on-chain cryptocurrency prediction records on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.29). An admin initialises a vault of Pyth feed addresses and a games PDA, then publishes a prediction snapshot against those oracles.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/zeroai-solana fork. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initvault, initgames, addgame, closegame)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/zeroai/
QA: devnet proof of initvault, initgames, addgame, and a rejected second initvault
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise addgame against Pyth feeds that are fresh within 60 seconds so closeprice is non-zero, and add a closegame fixture
